scenes.title: $~Program to̍h-sī ta̍t
scenes.subtitle: $~Piáu-ta̍t-sik, m̄-sī kù-á
lines: FunctionDefinition
cheerful

$~Hoan-gîng lâi-kàu @wordplay! Guá thiann-kóng lí tsiām-sî ū ha̍k-kòe tsió-khuá siá thîng-sik. Hó-tsiah! Tsit-ê té-té ê sing-sī, ōe kā lí kóng Wordplay kap pa̍t-ê siánn-tsè sio-kâng, siánn-tsè bô-kâng.

$~Kā lí kóng tsit-ê hua-bīn ê mi̍h-kiānn, tsit-tsiah hia̍h-bīn ū @tutorial tuì-ōe-khuànn kap @project khuànn-hôo. Lí thang khuànn-tio̍h *bú-tâi* @UI/stage, tsiah-ê ē tshut-hiān program ê kiat-kó, ê-tsāi *@editor* @UI/editor, tō-sī program @code.
$~Tsit-ê program sī khang-khang ê, in-ūi án-ne kiat-kó tsí-sī kiò lí khì siá program ê thê-sī.
$~Iáu-ū tsin-tsē pa̍t-khuán ê khòng-tsè, thang khòng-tsè program ê tsāi-khai kap tsam-thîng, mā thang pian-tsi̍p code, m̄-koh tsit-má bián siūnn.
FunctionDefinition
happy
$~Tsin-tsē thîng-sik @languages, program sī it-tsuā kù-á, kā tiān-náu kóng *tsò* siánn, pí-lūn kóng tá̍k-tshut @value:
$~\py|print("hi")\js|console.log('hi')\jv|System.out.println("hi");\
$~Tī @wordplay, program sī *piáu-ta̍t-sik*, kóng program ê /kiat-kó/ tio̍h-sī siánn, m̄-sī kóng án-nuá tsò-tshut-lâi.
$~Tsit-ê program ê kiat-kó sī ta̍t \'hāi'\, jiân-āu ē tī bú-tâi khuànn-tio̍h. Bô tá̍k-ìn ê bīng-līng, tsí-ū tsi̍t-ê @expression kóng ài sǹg-tshut siánn-ta̍t.
Bind
neutral
$~Tī pa̍t-ê gí-giân, *piàn-sòo* sī tsi̍t-ê ū miâ ê ki-tsiah, ê-tsāi @value, in ê ta̍t thang piàn:
$~Tī @wordplay, ū miâ ê ta̍t bē-tàng piàn. In sī 'bē-piàn-tit' ê, ì-sù sī bē-tàng koh hōo sin ê ta̍t. Tse tō-sī guán kiò in @Bind, m̄-sī @variable, in-ūi in bē-piàn.
$~Guán tsi̍t-ē-á ē kóng, án-nuá bô-iōng ē-piàn ê piàn-sòo, tō thang siá ē-tàng hù-tōng ê program.

scenes.title: $~Kiám-tsa tiâu-kiānn
lines: Conditional
neutral
$~Pa̍t-ê thîng-sik @languages lóng ū *if* kù-á, ūi-tio̍h @condition tsò bô-kâng ê tāi-tsì:

$~Tī @wordplay, tsit-tsuā lóng sī @expression, in-ūi án-ne @Conditional sī tsi̍t-ê *piáu-ta̍t-sik*, sian siá tiâu-kiānn, jiân-āu \?\, koh siá tio̍h ê piáu-ta̍t-sik kap m̄-tio̍h ê piáu-ta̍t-sik. Bián siánn-mih koan-kiàn-jī.
FunctionDefinition
curious
$~Ū-ê gí-giân mā ū *switch* kù-á, ūi-tio̍h @value tsò bô-kâng ê tāi-tsì:
$~@wordplay ū @Match, ē ēng ta̍t lâi kéng kiat-kó.
FunctionDefinition
excited
$~Ū-ê gí-giân mā ū *null coalescing* @operator, tng @variable sī null á-sī bô tīng-gī, ē hōo tsi̍t-ê siông-sî ê @value:
$~@wordplay ū @Otherwise ūn-sǹg-hû, thang tit-tio̍h kāng-khuán ê kiat-kó.

scenes.title: $~Ta̍t kap luī-hîng
lines: FunctionDefinition
neutral
$~Tsin-tsē gí-giân ū tsin-tsē 'ki-pún' @value luī-hîng.
$~@wordplay tuì-tsia-ê luī-hîng ū sio-kāng ê siá-huat, m̄-koh mā thang ka-ìn pa̍t-khuán sin-sik, ê-tsāi tuì to-gí bûn-jī ê @language @markup, kap sò-jī ê tan-uī.
FunctionDefinition
excited
$~Thîng-sik gí-giân mā ū tsò ta̍t ê tsi̍p-ha̍p ê pān-huat, ê-tsāi List, set, kap map (tsia̍p-tsia̍p kiò-tsò dictionary á-sī hash):
$~@wordplay tuì-tsia-ê tsi̍p-ha̍p ēng bô-kâng ê siá-huat, siōng ū miâ-sī ēng khang-keh lâi hun-khui ta̍t, m̄-sī ēng tāu-hō.
FunctionDefinition
curious
$~Ū-kuá thîng-sik gí-giân ē-sái lí kā @variable ê @type tsí-tīng, án-ne lí tō ē-tàng khak-tīng lí iōng piàn-sòo ê múi-tsi̍t-khuán pān-huat lóng sī tio̍h ê:

$~\py| list: list[int] = [1, 2, 3]\js| // JavaScript doesn't have type annotations. TypeScript does though:
let list: number[] = [1, 2, 3];\jv| List<Integer> list = Arrays.asList(1, 2, 3);\

$~@wordplay mā ū luī-hîng, m̄-koh luī-hîng sī *tuī-lūn* ê. Lí piàn-siông bián sian-kóng, put-guân ū-sî-á nā tuī-lūn bô-tit, lí tio̍h ka-kī siá. List luī-hîng mā ē-sái kā list lāi-té múi-ê uī-tì ê luī-hîng kóng-tshut-lâi, ná-tshiūnn \[# '']\ tō sī kóng list ê tsi̍t-tsióng sī tsiām-tsiām nn̄g-ê tāi-tsì: tsi̍t-ê sò͘-bo̍k, ê-ni̍h tsi̍t-ê tsu.
FunctionDefinition
curious
$~Thîng-sik gí-giân siông-siông mā ē-sái lí ka-kī tsò sū-liāu luī-hîng, kā tsiok-tsē ta̍t ha̍p-tsò-hóe, piàn-tsò tsi̍t-ê sū-liāu kiat-kò:
$~@wordplay iōng put-tông ê kí-huat lâi siá @Structure, iōng \•\ lâi tāi-piáu sū-liāu luī-hîng, jiân-āu sī @name, āu-piah sī kiat-kò lāi-té ê lân-uī.

scenes.title: $~Tsuán-uānn, tsip-ha̍p, kah hâm-sòo
lines: FunctionDefinition
curious
$~Thîng-sik siá-tsok siông-siông ū tsi̍t-ê tsok-tsō, tō sī kā sū-liāu uì tsi̍t-ê @type tsuán-uānn kàu lēng-gua̍h tsi̍t-ê. Pí-uí-kóng, lán khó-lêng beh kā sò͘-bo̍k tsuán-uānn tsò @value tsu:
$~\py| str(1)\js| String(1)\jv| String.valueOf(1)\

$~@wordplay ê ta̍t lóng ū @Convert ê kiat-kò, ē-sái lí tī luī-hîng tsiong-kan tsuán-uānn. Tsit-ê é-tsú kā \1m\ tsuán-uānn kàu ing-tshioh, jiân-āu koh tsuán-uānn kàu @Text. Múi-tsi̍t-tsióng luī-hîng ê ta̍t lóng ū tsi̍t-tsūn ê tsuán-uānn thang iōng.
FunctionDefinition
neutral
$~Tuì list kah array hit-lō ta̍t ê tsip-ha̍p, pa̍t-ê thîng-sik @languages iōng *for* kah *while* huê-khuan hit-lō kiat-kò, uì í-keng ū ê tsip-ha̍p ê ta̍t tsò-tshut sin ê tsip-ha̍p.

$~@wordplay ū tsi̍t-ê kán-tan ê @Translate* kiat-kò, iōng \↦\ hû-hō: i tsò-tshut sin ê @List, @Set á-sī @Map, kā múi-tsi̍t-hāng (iōng \⬚\ @placeholder lâi tāi-piáu) thè-tsò sin ê @value. Tse kā múi-hāng ka-pē, tsò-tshut \[2 4 6]\.
$~Mā ū koh khah kiông ê hāng-bo̍k, ná-tshiūnn @List.translate kah @List.combine, nā lí tshuì-iàu khah hok-tsap ê tsok-tsō.
FunctionDefinition
happy
$~Múi-tsi̍t-ê thîng-sik gí-giân lóng ū hâm-sòo, ē-sái lí siá-tshut ē-tàng tsiông-iōng ê @blocks ê @code, siu-tio̍h ìn-ji̍p, jiân-āu uì i sán-seng ìn-tshut, hok-tsap tshing-tō bô hān-tsè:
$~@wordplay mā ū hâm-sòo ê tīng-gī, m̄-koh iōng ƒ hû-hō. Kap Wordplay ê ta̍k-ê thîng-sik tsiâu-kâng, hâm-sòo tio̍h kè-sǹg tsò tsi̍t-ê @value.

scenes.title: $~Ìn-tshut sī bûn-jī ê, ìn-ji̍p ē huán-ìng

lines.edit: Stage([Phrase('🎉' resting:Sequence({0%: Pose(scale: 1) 50%: Pose(scale: 1.5) 100%: Pose(scale: 1)} duration: 2s))] background: Color(90% 0 0°))

lines: Stage
neutral
$~Pa̍t-ê thîng-sik @languages kā bûn-jī ìn kàu console, tī canvas tsiūnn-bīn tô-tshut-lâi, á-sī kái-piàn bāng-ia̍h:
$~\py| print('hi')\js| document.body.append('hi')\jv| System.out.println("hi");\
$~@wordplay ê ìn-tshut sī bûn-jī ê: @Phrase, @Group, á-sī @Stage, tī phiann-á-bīn khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū iūnn-sik, ē tín-tāng, ē hōo lâng ka-tsi̍p ê bûn-jī, á-sī hōo phiann-á tha̍k-khì thūn lâi thiann.
$~Ē-té ê é-tsú ū tsi̍t-ê @Stage, lāi-té ū tsi̍t-ê @Phrase, i ū tsi̍t-ê pn̄g-khiā ê sak-hòng tín-tāng.
FunctionDefinition
neutral
$~Tsiok-tsē thîng-sik gí-giân lóng ū pān-huat uì ēng-tsiá siu ìn-ji̍p:

$~\py| name = input('What is your name?')\js| const name = prompt('What is your name?')\jv| Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
String name = scanner.nextLine();\

$~@wordplay ê ìn-ji̍p lâi-uân sī *@streams*, i sī ē tuè sî-kan piàn-hòa ê tsin-tsiânn-sī ta̍t, in-uī ìn-ji̍p ê huán-ìng ê guân-in, hōo Wordplay thîng-sik iōng tsu-liāu-liû ê sin ta̍t tsài-lài kè-sǹg tsi̍t-piàn.

$~Pí-uí-kóng, tsit-ê thîng-sik iōng @Time tsu-liāu-liû lâi khuànn-tāng tē-kiû emoji ê soân-tīng. Múi-pái @Time() tsu-liāu-liû tin kàu sin ê @value, thîng-sik tō iōng sin ta̍t tsài-lài kè-sǹg, kā thîng-sik tī @Stage ê ta̍t keng-sin.
FunctionDefinition
curious
$~Tsiok-tsē pa̍t-ê thîng-sik gí-giân, beh ū @sideEffect ê ī-tōng, tio̍h tsù-tsheh event handler kah callback:

$~Tī @wordplay lāi-té, lán kan-nā iōng tsu-liāu-liû, ná-tshiūnn @Button, @Key, kah @Pointer, tō ē-sái tsò-tshut ē huán-ìng ê @elements. Tsit-ê @Phrase ê bûn-jī sī kin-tsù @Button ū-tio̍h-bô hőo lâng tshi̍h, iōng @Conditional lâi khuànn @Button tsu-liāu-liû ū-bô @Changed.
FunctionDefinition
happy

$~Pa̍t-ê thîng-sik gí-giân ē-sái lí tī ūn-hîng ê sî-tsūn kái @variables ê ta̍t, tse tsò-tshut ē-tàng tín-tāng ê, ē huán-ìng ê ìng-iōng thîng-sik ū-iōng. M̄-koh in iau-kuè lí tio̍h kì-tit tī tio̍h ê tē-hng keng-sin ta̍t, ma̍h ta̍t piàn-hòa ê sî, mā tio̍h keng-sin phiann-á-bīn ê hián-sī:

$~@wordplay iōng @Reaction @expression lâi kán-tan-hòa tse, i uì tsi̍t-ê khai-sí ta̍t khai-sí, tshâ tsi̍t-ê tsíng-tio̍h tsu-liāu-liû ìn-ji̍p ê @condition, jiân-āu uì tsu-liāu-liû ê piàn-hòa lâi keng-sin piáu-ta̍t-sik ê ta̍t. Tsit-ê é-tsú, múi-pái @Button tsu-liāu-liû piàn-hòa, lán tō keng-sin count ê ta̍t, án-ne tī @Stage hián-sī ê @Phrase tō ē tuè-tio̍h piàn.

scenes.title: $~Tshiong-tu̍t kah tī-bāng (debug)
lines: FunctionDefinition
angry
$~Pa̍t-ê @languages ē tshut *tsò-gō* — tse sī thîng-sik tsò-tshut put-tsún ê tāi-tsì ê kì-hō:
$~\py|1 + 'hello'\js|1 + 'hello'\jv|1 + "hello"\
$~@wordplay kā tshò-gō kiò-tsò *@conflicts*: nn̄g-kiānn bē-sái tsò-hué sī tsin ê tāi-tsì, tsiū-nái lí khuànn ē-bīn ê tsîng-sik, ka-tsuē bé-sòo kap bûn-jī.
$~Wordplay ē tī tshiong-tu̍t ê tē-hng liàm-sion-sènn, koh tī pinn-á-lán @UI/conflict khuànn-tio̍h. I mā ē kā lí kiàn-gī án-ni khah-hó kái-kuat būn-tê.
FunctionDefinition
happy
$~Tsin-tsuē thîng-sik gí-giân lóng ū tsi̍t-kuá tiāu-tshì ke-tsu̍t, tshòng lí hó-khuànn ê-tsiah-kah @code ê būn-tê. Put-kò ū-ê tsí-sī iōng print ê kì-liông, tī console khuànn @variables ê @values:
$~\py|print(elapsed)\js|console.log(elapsed)\jv|System.out.println(elapsed)\

$~@wordplay ū khah-tsiok ê tiāu-tshì ke-tsu̍t, hōo lí kā i ê tsiânn-sū *tńg-tsîng* kap *tńg-āu* tsi̍t-pōo-tsi̍t-pōo kiâⁿ. Tshiánn tī bú-tâi téng-bīn ê mô-tsik-sûn-suh @UI/modeSwitcher ê ⏸️ tiāu-tshì khoàinn-ǹg, tsìn-ji̍p *tiāu-tshì* mô-tsik: múi-ê @expression ê ta̍t ē tī thîng-sik-bé piⁿ-á hián-sī, @UI/stepControls ē kiâⁿ hōo lí khuànn, lí tō khuànn-tit ta̍t sī án-tsuànn khí-kiàn ê. Tsia ū ji̍t-á ê tsí-lō-tsuā: @Tour/stage
$~Tshun-ê mô-tsik mā tsin tiōng-iàu: ✏️ *pian-tsi̍p* mô-tsik thang kái thîng-sik, bú-tâi lóng bô tín-tāng; ▶️ *khan-sī* mô-tsik tō ē sìn-sì-kan ūn-sing, tsiàu lí ê su-ji̍p lâi hôe-ìng.
$~Siūnn beh khah-tsē tsí-tsuā? Bú-tâi miâ-á piⁿ-á ê @UI/stageTourLaunch khoàinn-ǹg ē kā lí sú-iōng tsiah-ê khóng-tsè ê tsí-lō-tsuā.

scenes.title: $~Ha̍p-tsò-hué
lines: FunctionDefinition
happy
$~Lán ēng saⁿ-pōo lâi tsò tsi̍t-ê sió-sió ê @project ē kah-tī hôe-ìng ê.
$~*Tē-it:* sing-bîng lí ê tsu-liāu kap *@streams*. Tsia ū tsi̍t-ê miâ-tsò elapsed ê @Time tsu-liāu-liû, kā lí kóng thîng-sik ūn-sing tsin-kú ah.
FunctionDefinition
neutral
$~*Tē-jī:* tuì tsu-liāu-liû *hôe-ìng*, khí-kiàn sin ê @Bind @values. Tsia turn kā elapsed ê sî-kan tsuán-tsò tō-sòo, elapsed ū piàn ê sî tō koh-tsài sǹg.
FunctionDefinition
happy
$~*Tē-saⁿ:* *su-tshut* — kā lí ê tsu-liāu tuì-ìng kàu tsi̍t-ê @Phrase, @Group, ia-sī @Stage. Tsit-má sing-á ē ka-kī tńg-tsuan lah!
FunctionDefinition
happy
$~Lán mā thang ke-thiam iōng-tsiá ê su-ji̍p lâi khóng-tsè tńg-tsuan, tsiūnn-nái @Volume ê mài-khuè-hong su-ji̍p. I sī 0 kàu 1 tsiong-kan ê ta̍t, sóo-í lán thang kā i tuì-ìng kàu 360 tō.

$~Tse tō sī tsin-tsuē tsuan-àn ê hîng-sik: sing-bîng, jiân-āu hôe-ìng, siōng-āu su-tshut. <Tsí-lâm@://guide> ū tsi̍t-ê @how tuānn-lo̍h, kâng-tsuā lóng sī hó-khuànn ê tsò-huat, thang ha̍k, khóo-pih, kap kái.
$~Khuài-lo̍k tsòng-tsok!
